codes.APP_CRASHED: Cheetah3D exited while a request was in flight.
codes.APP_BUSY: Cheetah3D is busy (long operation); retry later.
codes.TRIGGER_FAILED: The bridge macro could not be triggered (menu disabled, modal open, bridge not installed or menu not refreshed).
codes.BLOCKED_BY_MODAL: A dialog is open in Cheetah3D.
codes.WRONG_DOCUMENT: The front document is not the expected one.
codes.PERMISSION_MISSING: Accessibility or Screen Recording permission missing.
codes.AMBIGUOUS: Reference matches several objects; use id.
codes.UNSUPPORTED: Not supported by Cheetah3D 8.1.3 or not yet verified.
codes.CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Destructive action needs confirm:true or user elicitation.
codes.RUNTIME_STUCK: Runtime reports busy for too long while the app responds.
codes.DEPENDENCY_FAILED: An earlier op this op depends on failed.
codes.NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_PROFILE: Tool disabled in the active profile.
